questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The best teams in World Cup history
Whether Qatar should host the World Cup
How the new football stadiums were built
Why football fans travel abroad so often
questions.why: Beth says they'll ask: is it right for Qatar to host the World Cup?

questions.q: Why is the 2022 World Cup taking place in winter?
options: Summer temperatures in Qatar are over 45 degrees
The stadiums weren't ready in summer
Players asked for a change
There were too many other events in summer
questions.why: Beth says because temperatures exceed 45 degrees in summer, the competition was moved to winter.

questions.q: Which criticism of Qatar is mentioned?
options: It has too many noisy football fans
It is too far from Europe to travel to
It has no football tradition, just money
It has too few hotels for all the visitors
questions.why: Neil says Qatar has no tradition of playing football and some criticise the focus on money.

questions.q: What share of Qatar's workforce are foreigners?
options: About half
Around 25%
About 75%
questions.why: Beth says 95% of the total workforce are foreigners.

questions.q: According to Rothna Begum, what happened to some workers?
options: They paid huge fees but got short visas
They were paid much more than promised
They were given free housing and flights
They were allowed to bring their families
questions.why: She says workers paid exorbitant recruitment fees for two-year contracts, then got three-month visas.

questions.q: Why did many workers go home in debt?
options: They spent all their money on football tickets
They couldn't earn back what they had paid
Their families asked them for too much money
They lost their money in accidents at work
questions.why: They couldn't recoup the price they'd paid for the job, so many returned home in debt.

questions.q: According to James Dawsey, why is Qatar hosting the World Cup?
options: Mainly to make a lot of money
To improve its national football team
To attract new workers from Asia
To increase its influence as a small state
questions.why: He says it's not about economics; Qatar's policy is geared towards soft power.

questions.q: Why does James Dawsey mention Saudi Arabia and Iran?
options: Because they will also host the World Cup
Because they are Qatar's main trading partners
They are huge neighbours around small Qatar
Because their teams are the favourites to win
questions.why: He says Qatar is sandwiched between these two regional behemoths.
